Verses.VerseAr: صٓ‌ وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ ذِىۡ الذِّكۡرِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Sad. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.) By the Holy Qur’an, full of direction and guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: بَلِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فِىۡ عِزَّةٍ وَّشِقَاقٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But the disbelievers are in (the trouble of undue and unjust) conceit and arrogance, (suffering from) opposition and enmity (against Our Esteemed Prophet).

Verses.VerseAr: كَمۡ اَهۡلَـكۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍ فَنَادَوا وَّلَاتَ حِيۡنَ مَنَاصٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: How many a community We have destroyed before them! And they started crying (on seeing the torment), when there was no time left for deliverance (and release).

Verses.VerseAr: وَعَجِبُوۡۤا اَنۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مُّنۡذِرٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ‌ وَقَالَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ هٰذَا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ‌ ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they wondered that a Warner had come to them from among themselves and the disbelievers said: ‘He is a magician, a great liar.

Verses.VerseAr: اَجَعَلَ الۡاٰلِهَةَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًا    ۖۚ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَىۡءٌ عُجَابٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Has he turned all the gods into one God? That is indeed a very strange thing!’

Verses.VerseAr: وَانْطَلَقَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡهُمۡ اَنِ امۡشُوۡا وَاصۡبِرُوۡا عَلٰٓى اٰلِهَتِكُمۡ‌ ‌ۖۚ‌ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَىۡءٌ يُّرَادُ ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And their chiefs (stood up terminating their meeting with the Holy Prophet at Abu Talib’s house) and walked out saying (to the rest of the people): ‘You also walk out and be firm-footed in (worshipping) your gods. There is for sure some motive (and purpose) behind it.

Verses.VerseAr: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهٰذَا فِىۡ الۡمِلَّةِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ   ۖۚ اِنۡ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا اخۡتِلَاقٌ  ‌ ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: We have not heard of this (belief in the Oneness of God) even among the last community (of Christianity or the religion of Quraysh). This is but a fabricated lie.

Verses.VerseAr: اَءُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ الذِّكۡرُ مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِنَا‌ؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِىۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرِىۡ‌ۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Has this Admonition (the Qur’an) been sent down to him alone out of all of us?’ To be more precise, they are (caught) in doubt about My Admonition. But in truth they have not yet tasted My torment.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمۡ خَزَآٮِٕنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡوَهَّابِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do they have the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, Who is Almighty, the Most Benevolent?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ مُّلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا‌ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَسۡبَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or do they possess the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them? (If so,) then they should tie up ropes and climb up (to heaven).

Verses.VerseAr: جُنۡدٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُوۡمٌ مِّنَ الۡاَحۡزَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They are just a worthless army of the armies (of the disbelievers) that is about to be badly defeated at this very place.

Verses.VerseAr: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ وَّعَادٌ وَّفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُوۡ الۡاَوۡتَادِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Before them the people of Nuh (Noah) and ‘Ad and (also) Pharaoh, the powerful king (who tortured with stakes), belied and disbelieved;

Verses.VerseAr: وَثَمُوۡدُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍ وَّاَصۡحٰبُ لْئَیْكَةِ‌ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Thamud and the people of Lut (Lot) and the dwellers of (the Wood) al-Aika (i.e. the people of Shu‘aib) too (denied). These were the large armies.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Each (one of these) people rejected the Messengers and My torment became inevitable (for them).

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا يَنۡظُرُ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِنۡ فَوَاقٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And all of them are waiting for a single Mighty Blast (Shout) in which there will be no deferment.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they say: ‘O our Lord, give us hastily our share even before the Day of Reckoning.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِصۡبِرۡ عَلٰى مَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَاذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوٗدَ ذَا الۡاَيۡدِ‌ۚ اِنَّـهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O My Esteemed Beloved!) Continue observing patience with what they say and remember Our servant Dawud (David), who had great power. Certainly he was ever-turning (to Us in repentance).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا الۡجِبَالَ مَعَهٗ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِالۡعَشِىِّ وَالۡاِشۡرَاقِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed We put mountains under his command which (joining him) used to glorify Me evening and morning,

Verses.VerseAr: وَالطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُوۡرَةً   ؕ كُلٌّ لَّـهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the birds also that used to flock (in his presence), each would turn towards him (seeking to obey his commands).

Verses.VerseAr: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهٗ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ الۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ الۡخِطَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We strengthened and stabilized his state and regime, and blessed him with wisdom, insight and a decisive (and distinctive) oratory.

Verses.VerseAr: وَهَلۡ اَتٰٮكَ نَبَؤُا الۡخَصۡمِ‌ۘ اِذۡ تَسَوَّرُوۡا الۡمِحۡرَابَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And has the news of the contenders reached you when they jumped over the wall and entered the chamber of worship (of Dawud [David])?

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلٰى دَاوٗدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡ‌ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡ‌ۚ خَصۡمٰنِ بَغٰى بَعۡضُنَا عَلٰى بَعۡضٍ فَاحۡكُمۡ بَيۡنَنَا بِالۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَاهۡدِنَاۤ اِلٰى سَوَآءِ الصِّرَاطِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When they came inside to Dawud (David), he felt nervous. They said: ‘Do not feel upset. We are two parties in a dispute. One of us has wronged the other. So judge between us with truth and justice, and do not exceed limits, and lead us towards the right path.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ هٰذَاۤ اَخِىۡ لَهٗ تِسۡعٌ وَّتِسۡعُوۡنَ نَعۡجَةً وَّلِىَ نَعۡجَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ اَكۡفِلۡنِيۡهَا وَعَزَّنِىۡ فِىۡ الۡخِطَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely, he is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one ewe. Yet he says: ‘Give it (also) to me,’ and he suppresses me in conversation (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ اِلٰى نِعَاجِهٖ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ الۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِىۡ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰى بَعۡضٍ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَقَلِيۡلٌ مَّا هُمۡ‌ؕ وَظَنَّ دَاوٗدُ اَنَّمَا فَتَنّٰهُ فَاسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهٗ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَّاَنَابَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Dawud (David) said: ‘He has done you a wrong in demanding your ewe to add to his own ewes, and it is true that most of the partners wrong one another except those who believe and do pious deeds, and such people are very few.’ And it occurred to Dawud (David) that We had put him to trial (through that dispute). So he prayed for forgiveness from his Lord and fell down prostrate and turned (to Allah) in repentance.

Verses.VerseAr: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهٗ ذٰلِكَ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنۡدَنَا لَزُلۡفٰى وَحُسۡنَ مَاٰبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We granted him forgiveness and surely he enjoys special nearness in Our Presence and an exalted position (in the Hereafter).

Verses.VerseAr: يٰدَاوٗدُ اِنَّا جَعَلۡنٰكَ خَلِيۡفَةً فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَاحۡكُمۡ بَيۡنَ النَّاسِ بِالۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الۡهَوٰى فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَضِلُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيۡدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوۡا يَوۡمَ الۡحِسَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Dawud (David)! Verily We have made you (Our) vicegerent in the earth. So judge between the people (or rule) with Truth and Justice. And do not follow your desire or (this following the desire) shall turn you away from the path of Allah. Surely those who turn away from the path of Allah, for them is severe punishment because they forget the Day of Reckoning.

Words.MeaningEn: for it will lead you astray

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمَآءَ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَاطِلاً   ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا‌ۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنَ النَّارِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them without any purpose and good reason. It is the view and concept of the disbelievers (that this is a purposeless creation that came about by chance). So for disbelievers there is torment of the Fire of Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ  اَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ كَالۡفُجَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Shall We make those who have believed and do constructive works like those who corrupt the earth with destructive works, or shall We make the pious like the wicked?

Verses.VerseAr: كِتٰبٌ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ اِلَيۡكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوۡۤا اٰيٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ اُولُوۡا الۡاَلۡبَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This is a Blessed Book that We have revealed to you so that the wise may ponder over its Verses and seek direction and guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوٗدَ سُلَيۡمٰنَ‌ؕ نِعۡمَ الۡعَبۡدُ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗۤ اَوَّابٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We blessed Dawud (David) with (a son) Sulaiman (Solomon). How excellent a servant was he! He is indeed oft-returning to Allah in repentance.

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِالۡعَشِىِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الۡجِيَادُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When swift horses of fine breed were presented to him in the evening,

Verses.VerseAr: فَقَالَ اِنِّىۡۤ اَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ الۡخَيۡرِ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ رَبِّىۡ‌ۚ حَتّٰى تَوَارَتۡ بِالۡحِجَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He said (remorsefully): ‘I have committed love for wealth (i.e. horses) more than the love for the remembrance of my Lord until (the sun) disappeared behind the veil (of night).’

Verses.VerseAr: رُدُّوۡهَا عَلَىَّ  ؕ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحًۢا بِالسُّوۡقِ وَالۡاَعۡنَاقِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He said: ‘Bring them (horses) back to me.’ So he cut away their legs and necks (with a sword and thus he slaughtered his love for a position of nearness to Allah).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمٰنَ وَاَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلٰى كُرۡسِيِّهٖ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ اَنَابَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We put Sulaiman (Solomon also) to trial and placed an (unusually created) body on his throne. Then he regained (the regime).

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِىۡ وَهَبۡ لِىۡ مُلۡكًا لَّا يَنۡۢبَغِىۡ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنۡۢ بَعۡدِىۡ‌ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡوَهَّابُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He submitted: ‘O my Lord, forgive me and bestow on me such a reign that no one may have after me. Surely You are Most Benevolent.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ الرِّيۡحَ تَجۡرِىۡ بِاَمۡرِهٖ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ اَصَابَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We caused the wind to obey him. It used to blow gently under his command wherever he would desire (it) to go.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالشَّيٰطِيۡنَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَّغَوَّاصٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And all the jinn (and devils were also subdued to him) and every architect and diver (too),

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاٰخَرِيۡنَ مُقَرَّنِيۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَصۡفَادِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) other jinn bound in chains.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَامۡنُنۡ اَوۡ اَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah said:) ‘This is Our Bestowal. (Whether you) confer (it) on others or hold back (to you), no account will be asked for (in both the cases).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنۡدَنَا لَزُلۡفٰى وَحُسۡنَ مَاٰبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely he enjoys exclusive nearness in Our Presence and an exalted position in the Hereafter.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَاۤ اَيُّوۡبَۘ اِذۡ نَادٰى رَبَّهٗۤ اَنِّىۡ مَسَّنِىَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ بِنُصۡبٍ وَّعَذَابٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And mention Our servant Ayyub (Job) when he cried to his Lord: ‘Satan has afflicted me with great torture and suffering.’

Verses.VerseAr: ارۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَ‌ۚ هٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلٌ ۢ بَارِدٌ وَّشَرَابٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah said:) ‘Strike the ground with your foot. Here is a spring (of cool water) to bathe and drink.’

Words.MeaningEn: (is a spring of) water to bathe

Verses.VerseAr: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗۤ اَهۡلَهٗ وَمِثۡلَهُمۡ مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرٰى لِاُولِىۡ الۡاَلۡبَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We gave him his family and as many more (members of family) along with them, as a special Mercy from Us and as advice for the wise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثًا فَاضۡرِب بِّهٖ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡ‌ؕ اِنَّا وَجَدۡنٰهُ صَابِرًا‌ؕ نِّعۡمَ الۡعَبۡدُ‌ؕ اِنَّـهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Ayyub [Job]!) Take a broom of (hundred) twigs in your hand and strike (your wife once) with that (to fulfil your oath), and do not break your oath. Surely We found him steadfast. How excellent a servant was (Ayyub [Job])! Surely he was oft-returning (to Us) in repentance.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُرۡ عِبٰدَنَاۤ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ اُولِىۡ الۡاَيۡدِىۡ وَالۡاَبۡصَارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And mention Our servants Ibrahim (Abraham) and Ishaq (Isaac) and Ya‘qub (Jacob), who wielded great power and possessed vision.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَخۡلَصۡنٰهُمۡ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكۡرَى الدَّارِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We chose them for an exclusive (characteristic of) the remembrance of the home in the Hereafter.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّهُمۡ عِنۡدَنَا لَمِنَ الۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ الۡاَخۡيَارِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And verily in Our Sight they were of the chosen, exalted (and) most liked servants.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُرۡ اِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَالۡيَسَعَ وَذَا الۡكِفۡلِ‌ؕ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الۡاَخۡيَارِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) mention Isma‘il (Ishmael) and al-Yasa‘ (Isaaiah) and Dhu’l-Kifl (Ezekiel). All of them were of the chosen ones.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا ذِكۡرٌ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ لَحُسۡنَ مَاٰبٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This is the direction and guidance (which is cited in the first Verse of this Sura). And surely for the God-fearing there is a blessed abode.

Verses.VerseAr: جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الۡاَبۡوَابُ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (They are) the Gardens of Eden to live in forever. Their doors will be opened for them.

Verses.VerseAr: مُتَّكِـــِٕيۡنَ فِيۡهَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيۡرَةٍ وَّشَرَابٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There, reclining on cushions, they will be sitting (on couches), calling (at intervals) for plenteous fine fruits and (delicious) drinks.

Verses.VerseAr: وَعِنۡدَهُمۡ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرۡفِ اَتۡرَابٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And beside them will be pure women (houris) with eyes downcast (chastity conscious) and of equal age.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا مَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ لِيَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: These are the blessings which you are promised for the Day of Reckoning.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهٗ مِنۡ نَّفَادٍ ‌ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely this is Our provision which is never to exhaust.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا‌ؕ وَاِنَّ لِلطّٰغِيۡنَ لَشَرَّ مَاٰبٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This (is for the believers), and surely for the defiant there is an extremely evil abode.

Verses.VerseAr: جَهَنَّمَ‌ۚ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا‌ۚ فَبِئۡسَ الۡمِهَادُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (That is) Hell which they will enter and that is extremely evil bedding.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا  ۙ فَلۡيَذُوۡقُوۡهُ حَمِيۡمٌ وَّغَسَّاقٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This (is punishment); so they should taste it: boiling water and pus.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاٰخَرُ مِنۡ شَكۡلِهٖۤ اَزۡوَاجٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there is also a variety of (torments of) similar nature.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا فَوۡجٌ مُّقۡتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمۡ‌ۚ لَا مَرۡحَبًۢـا بِهِمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ صَالُوۡا النَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Guards of Hell or the inmates of Hell already there will say:) ‘This is an (other) army which is rushing into Hell along with you. There is no welcome for them. Surely they (too) are about to enter Hell.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ  لَا مَرۡحَبًۢـا بِكُمۡ‌ؕ اَنۡتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوۡهُ لَنَا‌ۚ فَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرَارُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They (the arrivals) will say: ‘In fact it is you to whom may there be no reception! It is but you who brought to us this (disbelief and torment). So (this) is an evil resting place.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا مَنۡ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابًا ضِعۡفًا فِىۡ النَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will say: ‘O our Lord, the one who brought for us this (disbelief or torment), increase his torment in Hell twofold.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰى رِجَالاً كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَشۡرَارِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they will say: ‘What is the matter with us that we do not see (those) persons (here) we used to count among the evil people?’

Verses.VerseAr: اَتَّخَذۡنٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا اَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ الۡاَبۡصَارُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Did we use to scoff at them (unjustly) or did our eyes miss (to recognize) them? (These were the sold-to-God souls like ‘Ammar, Khubab, Suhaib, Bilal and Salman, may Allah be well pleased with all of them.)

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ اَهۡلِ النَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely, this mutual dispute of the inmates of Hell is true.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا مُنۡذِرٌ‌‌ۖ وَّمَا مِنۡ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الۡوَاحِدُ الۡقَهَّارُ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I am only a Warner and there is no God except Allah, the One, the All-Dominant,

Verses.VerseAr: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡغَفَّارُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and (all) what is between the two, Almighty, Most Forgiving.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِيۡمٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘That (Day of Rising) is the tremendous piece of news.

Verses.VerseAr: اَنۡتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: You have turned your faces away from it.

Verses.VerseAr: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۭ بِالۡمَلَاِ الۡاَعۡلٰٓى اِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: I did not know of the Supreme Assembly (of angels on my own) when they were holding discussions (about the creation of Adam).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ يُّوۡحٰىۤ اِلَىَّ اِلَّاۤ اَنَّمَاۤ اَنَا۟ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The only Revelation that is sent to me (from Allah) is but I am a clear and straight Warner.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةِ اِنِّىۡ خَالِـقٌ ۢ بَشَرًا مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Recall that occasion) when your Lord said to the angels: ‘I am about to create a human organism from (moist) clay.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهٗ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِىۡ فَقَعُوۡا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then when I perfect its (visible body) and blow into its (invisible) self My Own (illumining) spirit, fall down prostrate before him (in his honour).’

Verses.VerseAr: فَسَجَدَ الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So all the angels fell down together prostrating themselves before him,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّاۤ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اِسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except Iblis. He showed arrogance (against the dignity of the Prophet) and became one of the disbelievers.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰۤاِبۡلِيۡسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَنۡ تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَىَّ‌ؕ اَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ اَمۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡعَالِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) said: ‘O Iblis, what has prevented you from falling down prostrate before his (Exalted Person) whom I have created with My Own (Benevolent) Hand? Did you show arrogance (to him) or were you (presuming yourself) high ranking?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اَنَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡهُ‌ؕ خَلَقۡتَنِىۡ مِنۡ نَّارٍ وَّخَلَقۡتَهٗ مِنۡ طِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Comparing himself with the Prophet,) he said: ‘I am better than he. You have created me from fire and You have created him from clay.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَاخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيۡمٌ‌ ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah said: ‘So get out from here (for the sin of insolence against the Prophet). Surely you are rejected.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِىۡۤ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الدِّيۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely My curse is on you till the Day of Resurrection.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنۡظِرۡنِىۡۤ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He said: ‘O Lord, then give me respite (to remain alive) till the Day when they are raised alive from the graves.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡظَرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah said: ‘(Be off,) you are surely of those who are granted respite,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الۡوَقۡتِ الۡمَعۡلُوۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Till the Day of the time which is appointed (and known).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَاُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He said: ‘By Your Honour, I shall certainly turn all of them away from the straight path with persistence,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ الۡمُخۡلَصِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except those of Your servants who are chosen and exalted ones.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَالۡحَقُّ وَالۡحَقَّ اَقُوۡلُ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah said: ‘So the Truth is (this), and the Truth I say,

Verses.VerseAr: لَاَمۡلئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنۡكَ وَمِمَّنۡ تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That I will fill Hell with you and with all those who will follow your (denigrating mindset).’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ مَاۤ اَسۡـَٔــلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ وَّمَاۤ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُتَكَلِّفِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I do not ask you for any reward for this (i.e. preaching of the Truth), nor am I of those who pretend.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This (Qur’an) is only direction and guidance for the whole world.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَاَهٗ بَعۡدَ حِيۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you will yourselves come to know its Truth after a while.’
